check: Balance sheet balances in every projected year
detail: Total assets less total liabilities and equity, worst year.

check: Cash flow statement reconciles to balance sheet cash
detail: Closing cash per the cash flow statement equals balance sheet cash.

check: Cash roll-forward is internally consistent
detail: Opening cash plus net change equals closing cash.

check: Debt roll-forward is internally consistent
detail: Opening debt less repayments equals closing debt in every year.

check: Debt schedule chains between years
detail: Closing debt in one year equals opening debt in the next.

check: Debt is fully repaid by the end of mine life
detail: A depleting orebody cannot support permanent leverage.

check: PP&E roll-forward is internally consistent
detail: Opening plus additions less depletion equals closing.

check: Depletable asset base is fully depleted at end of mine life
detail: Units-of-production depletion must exhaust the asset base with the orebody.

check: PP&E never goes negative
detail: Depletion cannot exceed the carrying value.

check: Terminal growth is below WACC in every scenario
detail: Required for the Gordon-growth cross-check to be finite and positive.

check: WACC x terminal-growth grid blanks any cell where growth >= WACC
detail: Cells where g >= WACC would be negative or explosive and are masked. With the configured ranges (max g 2.5% vs min WACC 8.0%) 0 cells require masking.

check: Diluted share count is positive and plausible
detail: Cross-checked against 205.5m shares outstanding at 2025-12-31 plus dilutive options.

check: Diluted share count is at least the basic count
detail: Dilution can only increase the count.

check: Every assumption declares a unit
detail: Unitless assumptions cannot be checked for consistency.

check: Fractional assumptions are expressed as decimals, not percentages
detail: A rate entered as 35 rather than 0.35 would silently distort the model.

check: No assumption is missing a value
detail: Every leaf in the assumption tree resolves to a number or a schedule.

check: Every reported fact and guidance item cites a source id
detail: Analyst judgements may stand alone; reported figures may not.

check: Every cited source id exists in the source register
detail: Unknown ids: none

check: Scenario values are correctly ordered (low < base < high)
detail: A low case that is not the lowest would mean the drivers are not linked as intended.

check: Scenarios differ materially from one another
detail: Scenarios that barely move indicate drivers are not genuinely flexed.

check: Each scenario carries its own discount rate
detail: Beta is flexed by scenario, so the WACC must differ across cases.

check: No NaN or infinite values in any model output
detail: All model frames are fully populated and finite.

check: AISC margin is positive in every producing year
detail: A negative all-in sustaining margin would mean mining at a loss.

check: Production never exceeds mineable inventory
detail: Cumulative production is capped by reserves plus credited resource conversion.

check: Equity value is positive in the base case
detail: A negative equity value would indicate a structural modelling error.

check: No source observation post-dates the valuation date
detail: All observations precede the valuation date.

check: Market price is available for the upside calculation
detail: Sourced from the latest close in the preserved market data.
